name: MORSEL
preparation: The original editor prepares genuine neural words and pitch/duration fits off the audio callback. The resulting validated bank is retained in plugin state and supports editor-closed/native offline playback.
liveMidiDifference: An unknown future MIDI gate cannot be offline-fitted in advance. Live voiced notes use a short crossfaded voiced sustain loop and release on key-off; authored pattern notes use the original prepared finite waveform and duration.
